   const results = parseLogLines(lines);\n\n    // Should have ~667 valid lines (1000 - ~333 empty)\n    expect(results.length).toBeGreaterThan(600);\n    expect(results.length).toBeLessThan(700);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('formatEvent - additional edge cases', () => {\n  const baseEvent: LogEvent = {\n    ts: 1709337600000,\n    worker: 'w-test',\n    level: 'info',\n    msg: 'Test message',\n occurrence (keep the event),\n50\t   * `false` if it is a duplicate (drop it).\n51\t   */\n52\t  check(event: NeedleEvent): boolean {\n53\t    if (event.sequence < 0) return true;\n54\t\n55\t    const key = `${event.session_id}\\0${event.worker_id}\\0${event.sequence}`;\n56\t    if (this.seen.has(key)) {\n57\t      this.droppedCount++;\n58\t      return false;\n59\t    }\n60\t\n61\t    this.seen.set(key, true);\n62\t\n63\t    // Evict oldest entries when over capacity\n64\t    if (this.seen.size > this.maxSize) {\n65\t      const excess = this.seen.size - this.maxSize;\n66\t      let count = 0;\n67\t      for (const k of this.seen.keys()) {\n68\t        if (count >= excess) break;\n69\t        this.seen.delete(k);\n70\t        count++;\n71\t      }\n72\t    }\n73\t\n74\t    return true;\n75\t  }\n76\t\n77\t  reset(): void {\n78\t    this.seen.clear();\n79\t    this.droppedCount = 0;\n80\t  }\n81\t\n82\t  get size(): number {\n83\t    return this.seen.size;\n84\t  }\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\t// ── Internal interfaces for legacy formats ────────────────────\n88\t\n89\tinterface NeedleWorkerObject {\n90\t  runner: string;\n91\t  provider: string;\n92\t  model: string;\n93\t  identifier: string;\n94\t}\n95\t\n96\tinterface NeedleLogEntry {\n97\t  ts: string;\n98\t  event: string;\n99\t  level?: string;\n100\t  session: string;\n101\t  worker: string | NeedleWorkerObject;\n102\t  data: Record<string, unknown>;\n103\t}\n104\t\n105\t// ── Main entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────\n106\t\n107\t/**\n108\t * Normalize a raw input into ne;\n303\t}\n304\t\n305\t// ── OTLP source stubs ─────────────────────────────────────────\n306\t\n307\t/**\n308\t * Normalize an OTLP LogRecord into NeedleEvent.\n309\t *\n310\t * Supports both
